name: ithaka
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Ithaka instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Ithaka tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Ithaka through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Ithaka Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Ithaka only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
